rv.q: Michael Grandage could hardly have made a better start to his five-show West End season than with this joyous revival of Peter Nichols's 1977 play with music.
The first season from the newly formed Michael Grandage Company starts brightly with this Seventies treat.
Dominic Cooke's excellent cast, including Emma Fielding and Stuart McQuarrie, are teasing and riveting.

cn.t: Grandage's joyous revival of Nichols's 1977 seriocomedy earns strong praise, with Simon Russell Beale stealing the show as drag queen Terri while the production deftly balances camp musical parody with darker political undertones.
